sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: Why did the train have to stall today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and frustrated, with a panicked sense of bad luck because her already shaky first-day start has been thrown off by the stalled train.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly startled and confused, her urgency momentarily giving way to wary curiosity as she notices something unexpected ahead.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts from frantic self-focused panic to immediate, open concern, sounding gently worried and ready to help the crying child despite being in a rush.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.text: Whoa, seriously? Don't move, okay? I'm here.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts instantly from frantic impatience to protective concern, feeling urgent sympathy for the lost boy and determined to steady him despite being late herself.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: ...Ah, man. Fine. First day and I'm already doomed.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels frustrated and resigned about being late, but her concern for the crying boy is overriding her own panic, leaving her flustered yet determined to help.
sprite_sequence.label: sadness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s pushing past her frustration and lateness to focus on helping the boy, sounding brisk and caring while trying to stay in control of the situation.
sprite_sequence.label: neutral

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, Kota. I'm Aoi. We're going to find your mom together.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quick shift from frustrated panic to determined, reassuring protectiveness, choosing to take charge and help the boy despite being late.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Did you come from the station? The bakery? Somewhere with lots of people?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and reassuring, with her earlier panic pushed aside by a practical, protective urgency as she tries to calmly narrow down where the boy came from.
sprite_sequence.label: neutral

sprite_sequence.text: Got it. Flower shop. Come on, hold my sleeve tight.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and reassuring, pushing aside her own panic about being late so she can take charge and make the frightened boy feel safe.
sprite_sequence.label: neutral

sprite_sequence.text: Excuse me! Did anyone see a woman looking for a little kid in a yellow cap?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and urgent, pushing aside her own panic about being late to sound clear and helpful while actively taking charge of the search.
sprite_sequence.label: neutral

sprite_sequence.text: It's okay. He stayed near the crossing. He was really trying to be brave.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and quietly proud, softening into warm reassurance as she downplays the crisis and praises the boy’s courage.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Next time, don't chase buses, okay? They're not that interesting.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s relieved and lightly teasing, using humor to hide how shaken and protective she still feels after helping the lost boy.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, wow. I am absolutely dead.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a mix of exasperated panic and resigned self-mockery about being late, but underneath it she’s relieved and quietly proud that she helped the boy.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless and resigned about being late, but deeply relieved and quietly proud that helping Kota was the right choice.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness
